description: This file implements a CommandSerializer that serializes commands into JSON format using Google Gson. It is an annotated Spring component with dependency injection of a specific JSON serializer.

classes.name: CommandSerializerDefaultToJson
classes.description: A Spring component that serializes command objects into JSON using a specific Gson serializer, implementing the CommandSerializer interface.

methods.name: CommandSerializerDefaultToJson
methods.description: Constructor with dependency injection of the JSON serializer.

methods.name: serializeCommandToJson
methods.description: Serializes the given command object into a JSON string using the injected serializer.
